create_client_helper: create a ClientHelper instance to track connected remote clients and manage idle kick warnings
activate_users: activate all users by resetting idle timers and clearing kick warnings for every connected client
display_latency_ms: get the current display latency in milliseconds for a specific user index
get_idle_time: get the current idle time in seconds for a specific user before potential kick
update_client_helper: update the client helper for a user by tracking idle state and calculating frame latency
